title: No bachelors, no biryani, no dogs: What your RWA can legally ban, and what it can’t

Disputes often arise from unclear rules and the need for greater transparency.

title: Centre gives nod to set up a bench of J&K HC in Ladakh
content:
NEW DELHI: The Centre on Thursday decided to set up a bench of high court of Jammu and Kashmir in Ladakh. In a post on X, Union home minister Amit Shah said the government is "fully committed" to the all-round development of Ladakh and claimed that the decision will enhance access to justice to citizens living in remote areas. "The Union cabinet, under the leadership of the PM Shri Narendra Modi Ji, has decided to set up a bench of the high court of Jammu and Kashmir in Ladakh," Shah said. "This will significantly enhance access to justice for citizens living in remote areas of Ladakh by reducing the time required to avail themselves of the legal services they are entitled to. The Govt is fully committed to the all-round development of Ladakh and to ensuring constitutional safeguards," he added.

title: NEET protests: SC sets up 5-member panel to probe excessive use of force by cops
content: the top court said a five-member panel will be headed by former SC judge justice R Subhash Reddy . the committee will examine allegations of excessive use of force against students during the student march over the NEET paper leak . it will also look into police surveillance, the proportionality of crowd-control measures, and the provision of medical assistance and compensation to victims .

title: Setback for Jharkhand students: HC stays Soren govt's order to cancel JPSC exams
content: government's order to cancel 11th and 13th JPSC exams and appointments stayed . comes days after the government cancelled the JSSC-CGL examination and all recruitment exams conducted by TDPL . chief minister Hemant Soren had announced the cancellation of the 14th and backlog examinations .
